svg.title: Control Studio's cascade against the single loop: 30 kW jacket loss
svg.desc: After Control Studio designed and applied the cascade, a 30 kilowatt loss in both jackets lowers the cascade's jacket by 0.544 degrees in the first tenth of a second; its inner loop raises the heater to 31.6 percent at once and the vessel dips only 0.086 degrees. The single loop waits for the vessel to cool, which falls 3.26 degrees at 16.3 seconds, and its heater passes 29 percent only after 26.4 seconds.
svg.text: Control Studio's cascade against the single loop: 30 kW jacket loss
Control Studio recording of this project's test after Apply · vessels held at 37 °C (cascade) and 35 °C (single loop) · numbers answer the predictions
The jacket falls first: −0.544 °C in 0.1 s
Single loop above 29 % only at 26.4 s
Jacket back within 0.1 °C of its setpoint at 3.8 s
